image_description: A grey whale breaching the surface of blue water, showing its head and upper back. The skin is dark with mottled white patches (barnacles). A copyright watermark '© Roi Hlaker' is visible across the center.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is angled steeply upward and partially submerged/obscured by spray; blowholes are not clearly visible from this angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin clearly shows the characteristic mottled pattern with white barnacle clusters against dark grey skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the back shows a series of small humps (knuckles) rather than a single prominent dorsal fin, consistent with grey whale anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the anterior section is visible; the full spindle shape cannot be verified due to cropping and water submersion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Consistent with the head checkpoint; texture and coloration match the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed or obscured by water/spray; internal baleen structures are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Pectoral fins are likely submerged or out of frame; not visible in this breach angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame/submerged.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin texture is rough with callosities.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The high-contrast white patches indicate the presence of barnacle callosities, giving the skin a rough appearance.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The watermark text '© Roi Hlaker' exhibits slight irregularity in letter spacing and edge sharpness typical of AI-generated text or compression artifacts, though it is largely legible.
The water splash lacks fine droplet detail and appears somewhat 'smudged' or painterly, blending into the background sky/water rather than having crisp physical boundaries.
